tips.label: Offer reassurance
tips.text: Give them space, reassure them, and distract them with a simple activity like looking at a photo album. Try to maintain a calm environment.

tips.label: Create a calm environment
tips.text: Reduce noise and clutter, maintain routines, and use gentle reassurance. Distract them with activities or food if they seem upset.

tips.label: Keep familiar surroundings
tips.text: Respect their space and keep familiar objects around. Build quiet times into the day to reduce stress and anxiety.

tips.label: Keep evenings calm
tips.text: This is known as sundowning, often caused by exhaustion or confusion over day and night. Encourage physical activity during the day and keep the evening calm and quiet.

tips.label: Support a sleep routine
tips.text: Maintain a routine, limit naps during the day, and avoid caffeine or sugary foods. Ensure the room is dark and safe for them to sleep.

tips.label: Make the bedroom comfortable
tips.text: Encourage physical activity during the day and keep the evenings calm. Make sure the bedroom is safe and comfortable with nightlights if needed.
